snippet.title: Crystal Harvest: Apex Operator Alpha Trailer (Play for free!)
snippet.description:
The game is available to wishlist here :

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4229620/Crystal_Harvest_Apex_Operator

Play the game here :

https://aligned-games.itch.io/crystal-harvest-apex-operator-beta

Welcome to the public alpha test for Crystal Harvest: Apex Operator. The purpose of this test is too see public reaction and to gather feedback on the game. This version will be the last public test before the demo.  

Crack, mine, and sell valuable crystals in this fast-paced incremental mining extraction roguelite. Earn currency to spend across upgrade categories with permanent progression and powerful builds in runs. Fight alien hordes, push into zones, and extract at the end of each run - or lose everything.
